claims: The 2026 MLB regular season officially kicks off on Wednesday, March 25.
A standalone game between the New York Yankees and San Francisco Giants occurs on March 25, 2026.
A full slate of games for all 30 teams is scheduled on Thursday, March 26, 2026.
A full slate of games for all 30 teams is scheduled on Friday, March 27, 2026.
The opening game is streamed exclusively on Netflix.
11 games are scheduled for the main Opening Day on March 26, 2026.
The NY Mets host the Pittsburgh Pirates at 1:15 p.m. ET on March 26, 2026.
The LA Dodgers host the Arizona Diamondbacks at 8:30 p.m. ET on March 26, 2026.
The Chicago Cubs host the Washington Nationals at 2:20 p.m. ET on March 26, 2026.
The Baltimore Orioles host the Minnesota Twins at 3:05 p.m. ET on March 26, 2026.
Max Fried (Yankees) vs. Logan Webb (Giants) on opening night.
